subject: Request: Variable payment window / pilot collection structure - Innovate Labs
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@innovatelabs.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Variable payment window request - Innovate Labs

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for a great demo last week. We want to move forward with Redwood for a pilot across two product teams, but our cash cadence this year is unusually bunched — finance is asking if Redwood would consider a temporary, variable payment window tied to milestones rather than strict monthly invoicing.

Conservative outline:
- Phase 1 (Q4/Q1): allow up to Net-90 on invoices for the first two quarters, capped at $250k outstanding.
- Phase 2 (starting Q2): revert to standard monthly invoicing and Net-30.

We can sign a short addendum and provide milestone acceptance certificates. I attached a short SOW and the payment plan spreadsheet for context. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Our priority is avoiding implementation delays while we smooth collections on our side. Please let me know who at Redwood needs to sign off.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
VP Finance | Innovate Labs
[Attachment: SOW_InnovateLabs_Q4.pdf]
[Attachment: PaymentPlan_Summary.xlsx]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@innovatelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Variable payment window request - Innovate Labs

Alicia — thanks for the clear outline and the docs. I appreciate the transparency on timing. I've started an internal thread to route this through Finance and RevOps so we can assess risk and outline required controls (credit check, milestone verifications, addendum language).

Next steps from Redwood side:
- Share payment plan and SOW with Finance for a conditional approval (Laura Bennett)
- RevOps (Jonas) to confirm billing system changes and limit enforcement
- Legal (Marissa) to draft a 90-day pilot addendum with milestone acceptance language and cap

Do you have a preferred signer for the addendum on your side? I included Tom Reynolds (billing lead) on cc. I'll loop back by end of day with what Finance needs.

—Priyom
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@innovatelabs.com>

Thanks Priyom — Tom can sign the addendum. I also attached our latest credit summary for transparency.

Notes on milestones: we will accept deliverables on a per-sprint basis (documented acceptance via email), and payment triggers are tied to acceptance. We prefer no upfront payment for this pilot, but are open to a small retainer if Redwood requires it.

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@innovatelabs.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@innovatelabs.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Variable payment window request - Innovate Labs — request for exec guidance

Team — forwarding Innovate Labs' request. Summary: customer requests a temporary, milestone-tied Net-90 allowance for up to $250k outstanding for two quarters as a pilot; reverts to standard terms afterward. Deal: RDW-7842.

Finance/RevOps/Legal please advise: what controls do we need to accept a pilot like this? Options I see: 1) conditional approval with 25% upfront if credit check flags; 2) require signed addendum + milestone acceptance emails as payment triggers; 3) apply a small fee (1–2%) for extended terms to offset risk.

Questions for each of you:
- Laura: credit risk / DSOs impact and suggested guardrails?
- Jonas: billing-engine limit setup and how quickly we can enforce a $250k cap?
- Marissa: suggested addendum language + required signatures?

Customer timeline: they want to start before Oct 15 to hit Q4 sprints. I flagged this as time-sensitive.

—Priyom

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@innovatelabs.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@innovatelabs.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Variable payment window request - Innovate Labs — request for exec guidance

Priyom / team — I've reviewed Innovate's credit summary. High-level: current credit exposure is manageable, but Net-90 materially increases our DSO risk if multiple customers follow similar pilots. Proposal for a conditional pilot:

1) Approve a 90-day pilot capped at $250k outstanding for RDW-7842 only.
2) Require a signed addendum and milestone acceptance emails as invoice triggers.
3) If Innovate's credit bureau score is below our threshold on a follow-up check, require 25% upfront for the first invoice and collect a 1.5% extended-term fee on invoices shipped under Net-90.
4) Finance will require weekly aging reports for the pilot duration and a mid-pilot review at 45 days to decide whether to continue.

If RevOps confirms we can programmatically cap outstanding invoices at $250k and Legal produces a short addendum by EOD, I can greenlight the pilot.

—Laura
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@innovatelabs.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@innovatelabs.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Variable payment window request - Innovate Labs — request for exec guidance

Priyom / team — conditional approval granted for pilot under the controls Laura outlined. Action items:
- Legal (Marissa): produce a 90-day pilot addendum with milestone acceptance language and the $250k cap; include the 1.5% fee clause as a fallback.
- RevOps (Jonas): configure billing cap and weekly aging report (I will run the first report on Oct 1).
- Finance (Laura): perform a follow-up credit check before first invoice; if score is below threshold, require 25% upfront.
- Sales (Priyom): obtain Innovate's signature (Tom) and confirm acceptance triggers (email addresses to use for milestone signoffs).

I'll mark RDW-7842 as 'Pilot - Conditional' in HubSpot and notify Revenue Ops to enable monitoring. Approved to proceed on a pilot basis; close coordination required.

—Jonas Weber
VP Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
